protocol.calibration: 4 separate 2062-token book excerpts; codebooks and head ranking fitted only here.
protocol.validation: 4 different excerpts, same four books; 7168 teacher-forced next-token targets after a 256-token warmup. Each codec tested with full downstream recomputation.
protocol.quantization: Actual keys immediately after k_proj and before RoPE. Fixed mean center per layer/KV head/component, uniform circular phase bins, per-pair log-companded radius levels. Decode and restore center before native RoPE. No attention shortlist; every causal key remains available.
protocol.prefix_protection: Protected family fits center/scales to calibration body keys excluding first14 tokens, and leaves first14 or32 pre-RoPE keys in native float32. Unprotected family fits to all calibration keys. These two changes are not separately isolated.
protocol.scope: K-only quantize/dequantize simulation. Queries and values not independently quantized. The effect propagates through all layers. No physical packed-cache implementation, runtime speedup, or 32k quality test is claimed.
protocol.memory: Packed payload estimates vs FP16 K (256B/key for D128). Prefix charged at FP32 (512B/key). Center + median + maximum codebook charged 1024B per KV head per cache, amortized over N2062. Potential full-KV ratio assumes V stays FP16; quality simulation retains native float32 V.
protocol.head_units: 28 layers ×2 KV heads =56 storage groups; each serves six query heads. Sensitivity interventions alter exactly one KV head at a time; errors are not additive.
protocol.uncertainty: 95% intervals resample four held-out excerpts. They do not establish robustness across other data domains. Changed-choice rate is disagreement with native model, not error rate against ground truth.

locked_protected_policies.criteria: loss_001/005/010: calibration mean delta NLL <= .001/.005/.01 and worst excerpt <= .005/.015/.03. No held-out selection. Most conservative 42-high fallback always validated.
locked_protected_policies.rank_source: Mean absolute per-document loss change when one KV group uses 3+3 unprotected quantization; calibration data only, heuristic rather than optimal.

locked_matched_policies.criteria: loss_001/005/010: mean delta NLL <= .001/.005/.01 and worst excerpt <= .005/.015/.03. Choice of policy locked before validation; most conservative hi8/42-head fallback also validated.
locked_matched_policies.rank_source: Mean absolute per-document loss change from matching protected 4+4 single-KV-head ablations; calibration only.
